notes.title: No more AI voices, we got a new cast with real actors now!
notes.notes:
We heard you well, we have changed the voices in the game! so now enjoy listening to real actors with powerful emotions!

Try the new demo update to listen the new voices!
Thanks for the new cast team:

Casting Director - Steve Lloyd

Voice Actors
Emma - MJ Guenther
Anderson - Steve Lloyd
Garry - Jeremy Tucker
Lucas - Jon DeBenedict
Unknown Caller - Ethan James Smith

notes.title: Playtest 0.3.5 thanks for trying the demo beta!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225949/09a6fef53a7df5ce698d9b69a79304d9a66d2679.png[/img]
I appreciate everyone's feedback, which was essential to discover several bugs and make the game feel better.
Here is everything in this new build:
[list]
[*] Changed the copyrighted music at reception so Youtubers can now publish videos about my game without worrying and monetization.
[*] English is the default language.
[*] Fixed the bug which locks the camera view if you answer the phone it chats with Lucas while sitting on the chair.
[*] Flashlight in the middle of the screen.
[*] Man's body is invisible when a shadow is cast at the basement.
[*] better glass material for windows.
[*] The player can't move out of the reception desk when Lucas visits the motel until he does the death gesture animation.
[*] You can't interact with NPCs until they reach their destination.
[*] better glowy material for the ghost of the required materials for refilling room 1 bathroom.
[*] removed duplicate sound when you try to open a locked door.
[*] better sitting on chair animation.
[/list]
